title: Broncos place a second round tender on CB Ja’Quan McMillian

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos place a second round tender on CB Ja’Quan McMillian
sources.description: According to multiple reports, including ESPN insider Jeremy Fowler, the Denver Broncos have placed a second-round tender worth $5.8 million dollars on cornerback Ja’Quan McMillian. Teams can still offer a contract to McMillian in free agency, but the Broncos would either have to match the contract or receive a second round pick in return for […]
